verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never shows Outlook offering an assistant that answers questions across the whole inbox and calendar with grounded answers. The Graph search and query APIs are developer building blocks, and searching via an external LLM/MCP integration is a user-side workaround. A passing community mention of a 'Copilot integration' does not describe cross-mailbox or calendar Q&A, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
